summary: If evaluating the throw expression is itself abrupt, propagate that abrupt completion instead of creating a second throw.

semantics.order: evaluate expression, GetValue, then throw that value
semantics.nested_abrupt: an exception while evaluating/GetValue of the expression propagates unchanged
semantics.side_effects: effects before the abrupt point remain observable

tests.name: getter throws before outer throw
tests.input: const o={get x(){console.log('get'); throw 'inner';}}; try{throw o.x}catch(e){console.log(e)}
